title: One venue, several kinds of approval
question: How many different City approvals does one bar, club or restaurant with entertainment hold?
finding: 57 venues with an active entertainment permit hold four or more different kinds of City approval at the same address in these files alone.
how: Addresses with an active entertainment permit, matched by street number and name to Public Works street-use permits, Fire Department operating permits and sign permits. Businesses are named as the City's entertainment-permit list names them.
limits: Holding several permits is what the rules require of these venues; none of this suggests anything wrong on their part. It is a measure of the load. Address matching is approximate, and health permits, State liquor licences and police permits are not in the files.
